name: Lolotte
message: 「Huff, huff, sorry to keep you waiting--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, 'always explore on your own two feet' is her moral♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, shall we get going right away?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big bro, you're grinning again. You pervert」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So, why is your little sister here?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Could you maybe let me join in on that, uh, exploring thing too?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh! So that's what this is about!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Having lots of companions is a wonderful thing, isn't it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Today is the perfect weather for exploring, so let's all have fun out there♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「T-Today's weather isn't very good, so let's save going out for another time……」

name: Macaron
message: 「Come on, we're already here, let's go exploring!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I still don't really know much about Ryuusei Town yet」

name: Macaron
message: 「I want you to teach me all sorts of things, Angel-chan」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm super interested in exploring, you know」

name: Lolotte
message: 「As a special favor, I shall guide you along my exploration route」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihihi, knew I could count on you, Angel-chan」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A-And that certain someone over there can just tag along if she wants to」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The blue sea--in other words, the lotion!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Um, if you're going to say that, wouldn't it be the ocean……?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mmph... Even I make mistakes sometimes, you know!」

name: Macaron
message: 「So, what kind of place is this?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, on a warm day, the sea breeze feels wonderful here.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How pathetic. Children are supposed to be children of the wind, you know.」

name: Macaron
message: 「What do you usually do in a cold place like this anyway?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I gaze out at the distant horizon, or reminisce about how things were before I came here.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hawawah! L-Let's go to the next place!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is where the shrine maiden lives.」

name: Shio
message: 「A torii gate is, in essence, a type of gateway marking sacred ground」

name: Shio
message: 「Good day to you, Lady Lolotte. Have you all come together to pay your respects?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm tagging along on Angel-chan's little expedition!」

name: Shio
message: 「Hoho, an expedition, you say. How splendid」

name: Shio
message: 「A pleasure to make your acquaintance. I am called Shio Asukai」

name: Shio
message: 「This shrine is renowned for its potent blessings, so why not offer a prayer while you are here?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「U-Umm…… would those happen to include blessings for, well, making up with someone……?」

name: Shio
message: 「A prayer for friendship, indeed. Why, of course」

name: Synn
message: 「If you're worried, you should go with her, Lolotte」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-It's not like I'm worried or anything……」

name: Macaron
message: 「If you leave her alone, she might get lost, you know~」

name: Macaron
message: 「Besides, if you don't hold onto her tight……」

name: Macaron
message: 「You have to chase after her and have a proper talk, right!」

name: Shio
message: 「A torii gate is also the boundary between the living world and the hidden realm, you see」

name: Shio
message: 「If left alone, she might just come back to haunt you, you know?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eeeek! Amyrina becoming a ghost--that would be terrible!」

name: Shio
message: 「My... Have I teased a bit too much?」

name: Macaron
message: 「All that's left is for the two of them to talk things out properly and make up!」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm, so that is how it is」

name: Shio
message: 「Not at all. If I can be of service to you all, I do not mind in the slightest」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm a little worried, so maybe I'll go check on them」

name: Macaron
message: 「They might end up needing my help, you know!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, let's just stick to watching how things play out」

name: Macaron
message: 「Mgh. That's what I was planning to do even without you telling me!」

name: Shio
message: 「Now, now, there is no need to be so impatient...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Mgh... How long are they planning to just stand there...」

name: Synn
message: 「They have their own pace, after all」

name: Macaron
message: 「You say that, and they've been stuck in a stalemate this whole time, haven't they」

name: Macaron
message: 「That's why I thought I'd give them a little push, and yet...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Um... right now, the Human World is very dangerous because of Re-Crea」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I already know that. I've heard it plenty of times.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even so, the Human World is a wonderful place」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I want you to see that too, Amyrina!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Besides, we have reliable friends who won't lose to something like Re-Crea...」

name: Synn
message: 「Doesn't look like it's going too well」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, it'd be bad to interrupt the two of them」

name: Macaron
message: 「If you pray, you get blessed, right?」

name: Shio
message: 「Huh? Well, yes, that is how it works, but...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Are you really okay with that, Lolotte...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「You put money in here, clap-clap, and then make a wish, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「C-Clapping harder doesn't mean you'll get more blessings......」

name: Macaron
message: 「I wish for Lil' Angel and Big Angel to make up real soon!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I wish for them to honestly tell each other how they feel!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Friends not being able to smile together is just way too much of a waste!」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if doing it like that is really okay......」

name: Shio
message: 「However, I believe Lady Macaron's sincerity got through to them」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Yet forgetting to actually listen to each other's words......」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even though we should have understood everything all along......」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm the one in the wrong for refusing to listen to what you had to say, Amyrina」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even though you were worried about me, I'm sorry」

name: Amyrina
message: 「No. I'm the one who should apologize, for not checking how you felt either, Lolotte... I'm sorry」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well then, this means we've made up, right」

name: Amyrina
message: 「It's all thanks to Macaron, isn't it」

name: Amyrina
message: 「We wouldn't have been able to face each other like this」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you two manage to make up?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What are you talking about, Mr. President」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We've been good friends right from the start. Right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha. Looks like the blessing already worked its magic」

name: Macaron
message: 「Mhm, that's the best thing of all」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Little sister, thank you very much for today」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It seems we've put you through quite a lot of trouble for our sake」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nah, I didn't really do anything big」

name: Amyrina
message: 「We were able to properly face each other with honesty」

name: Amyrina
message: 「It's all thanks to you giving us that push, Macaron」

name: Macaron
message: 「As long as I'm around, everyone has to get along」

name: Macaron
message: 「I won't allow any fighting, got it?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, Big Brother? Have you got a newfound respect for me now?」

name: Synn
message: 「I think being able to work hard for everyone's sake is an amazing thing」
Somehow, I feel like the meaning of "everyone" that the two of us use is starting to align.
Macaron is steadily getting closer to becoming her ideal Demon Lord.

name: Synn
message: 「As the Student Council President, I can't let myself fall behind either」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ahhh, no fair! I'm not gonna lose either!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well then, shall we continue our exploration!」

name: Shio
message: 「Not at all, please do visit again anytime」
